event: US jobs report Fri 6 Nov 15:30 SAST (65k expected, unemployment 4.2%)

bullets.title: Holding gains
bullets.text: Gold was last seen near 4,121 this evening (USAGOLD), after a high of 4,146.63, its best since 20 October; no later USD quote found (UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Dollar weak
bullets.text: The dollar kept sliding after Democrats won Congress, and the US 10-year yield is near 4.88%, its lowest in about two months.

bullets.title: Claims strong
bullets.text: US jobless claims fell to 189k against 197k expected (15:30 SAST), a firm jobs sign that can support the dollar.

bullets.title: Mixed data
bullets.text: ADP private jobs rose 86k (67k expected) while ISM services slipped to 54.5 (54.8 expected).

bullets.title: Hike risk
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about 79-82% odds of a December Fed hike (meeting 8-9 Dec), which caps how far gold can run.

bullets.title: BoE hiked
bullets.text: The Bank of England raised rates to 4.00% at 14:00 SAST, as expected, with no big gold reaction reported.

bullets.title: Friday's test
bullets.text: The jobs report is Friday 15:30 SAST, expected 65k after 29k, with unemployment at 4.2%; a beat could pull gold back toward 4,075 or 4,000.
